subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: Should this work land as staged bounded summaries and indexed pagination with the display manifest handled separately, or as one comprehensive publisher-read redesign?
rationale: The performance problem and expected invariants are clear, but the atomic scope affects migration risk, compatibility testing, and whether the display-manifest contract must be redesigned before the first improvement can land.

options.title: Stage the optimization
options.body: Land counter-backed profiles, lightweight memberships, lazy deletion inventory, and indexed kind pagination first, while tracking the display-manifest bound as an explicit follow-up.

options.title: Redesign all paths together
options.body: Require one change to bound every listed profile and catalog path, accepting a larger review and compatibility surface before any improvement ships.

recommendation.title: Stage the optimization
recommendation.body: Land counter-backed profiles, lightweight memberships, lazy deletion inventory, and indexed kind pagination first, while tracking the display-manifest bound as an explicit follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged profile/catalog work and detailed audit give them the strongest available context for selecting a safe implementation boundary.
